'''Yeltha''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Both system]] with a surface of molten searing rock. It had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
